notes.title: New update and bugfixs - Update v0.6
notes.notes:
[h1][b]How's going your new year?[/b][/h1]
[h3][i]Pretty good, i was fun on first public alpha stage. and got much feedbacks to need rebalance&fixs. [/i][/h3]

Also we didn't forget that 10 Jan happening right? 
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655512432986423327.png[/img]

[h1]Alpha stage has been publishing for everyone! [/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211290

So till [b]10 january[/b] i did much things to make stability game and implement some systems for more fun!

[h2]Then let me post these patch notes:[/h2]

[i]in this alpha stage: Everyone's complaining about: [b]"dynamic of the game is very slow."[/b] I know that map is too big but also we need break [b]law of physics[/b]. and [u]did[/u].[/i]

[h1]So[/h1]

[olist]
[h2][b][*]All minions are speedster![/b][/h2] 
[i]Like barry allen[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/0603928d2211b58d51a21774067a3045a2a1f849.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Removed Non-Enemy Base Speed
[*] Buffs Base Speed: 460> 750
[*] Buffs Tower damage reduction 20>95 (to converted percent: %37 depends damages.)
[*] Fixed Purgatorium Ranger attacks doesn't show arrow and give damage.
[*] Adjusted minions socializing AI
[/list]

[h2][b][*]All character stats has been rebalanced[/b][/h2] 
[h3][i]With standard stats:[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Nerfs Dash Speed: 1800,0>1600,0
[*] Buffs Run Speed: 750,0>875,0
[*] Buffs Stamina: 25>30
[*] Buffs Stamina Regen. : 1,0>3,0
[*] Buffs Stamina Regen. multiplier With running: 0,5>0,7 
[*] Added All elemental defenses: 0>65
[*] Added All elemental damage: 0>40
[/list]

[h3][i]Partizan:[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased speed arrows: 5000>9000 Velocity
[*]Deadly Rain ultimate skill are improved for CC's: Fire arrows into the sky to do cause a massive rain of arrows that do 60/90% Movement Slow instantly and (50/65) + (ShadowDMG%10/15} + {FireDMG%15/20}) damage every 0.5 seconds for 7/10 seconds.
[b]+While casting, gain skill immunes.[/b]
Casting time: 1.3 Second.
[/list]

[h3][i]Hibachi:[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed speed Shurikens: 5000>(6000/8000) velocity [b]depends distances[/b].
[*] Disabled Skill, Secret of Spiders: in this alpha stage matches, this skill has much bugs. so mechanism will change in the next update.
[*] Nerfed Skill, Shadow arrest: Destroy time: 50>30
[/list]

[h3][i]Stella:[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed Back Edge Strike skill mech:
Back Edge Strike is an offensive ability in which Stella strikes her enemy with the dull edge of her sword,  knockback them and rendering them unable to cast skills and attacks for 3/4.2/5.7 seconds in addition to causing 30/50/80(+{WindDMG})damage. 
[b]+For minions and jungle monsters, it will stun.[/b]
[strike][b]-if you use any skill or attacks while casting, it automatically cancel skill.[/b][/strike]
Casting time: 1.25> 1 Second.
[/list]

[h2][b][*]System Implements&Changes&Fixes[/b][/h2] 
[h3][i]Core of the game[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed In game Market rules: All items have limitations to buy. you cant buy more than max limitation.
[i]Otherwise how could you buy 10 boots and wear them ːsteamfacepalmː[/i]
[*] Changed Queue design. Also added counter for how many player are queued.
[*] Implemented Reward system. 
[*] Implemented Leveling and open slot. (These 2 locked slots opens when you reach 6 and 11 level.)
[*] Changed movement system (There no more W+W for dashing, only can Shift+W for dash.)
[*] Fixed Towers Health and Dead bugs
[*] Fixed effect isn't correct when you got jungle buffs.
[*] Fixed Auto graphics setting error when you trying first run game.
[*] Implemented camera shake value option in settings.
[*] Implemented Fps limit option for save power consuming in setting when backgrounded game
[*] Changed damage fonts and size. also removed others damage texts.
[*] Implemented CC's text. it will show when you got CC or to someone.
[*] Changed all AI's healths per tier lane. 
[olist]
[*]Tier1 Towers: 5.000 HP
[*]Tier2 Towers: 8.500 HP
[*]Inhibitor Guardians : 9.000 HP
[*]Inhibitors : 10.000 HP
[*]Base Guardians: 5.000 HP
[/olist]
[*] Fixed match stucks when you leaving the game during loading. 
[*] Fixed Character model combining bugs. 
[h3]And MORE! (i cant remember all what i did fixed or added things right now. but you can find them that what i did. Also i will change this page when i remembered. No worries.)[/h3]
[/list]
[h1]Last: [EVENT] Added a easter egg and hidden gate![/h1]
[i][h3]If you find it, you will earn 200 diamons![/h3][/i] [b][h3]Good Luck everyone♥[/h3][/b]
[u][b]Dont forget to take ScreenShot and post to our discord.[/b][/u]
[/olist]

notes.title: [UPDATE]-Patch v0.4
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/UokiPZVkCAzEGc5PJm/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]Much has improved since the previous patch. And much will be improving. Thanks to our Community! [/b]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/585140195398254642.gif[/img]
[h1]So, first I want to share game updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added an new tutorial system as you can see from the gif at the top og this page.
[*]All character's base speed has been increased:
[list]
[*]Base Speed: 600 > 750
[*]Dash Base Speed: 1600 > 1700
[*]Base Stamina: 20>25
[/list]
[*]All Minion's base speed has been increased:
[list]
[*]Non-Enemy Base Speed: 305>395
[*]To Enemy Base Speed: 416> 495
[/list]
[*]Hibachi's Secret of Spider skill got reworked about functions and effects. (No longer screen animation) and Functions are renewed again.
[*]Some networking optimizations
[*]Movement functions are renewed (New function is experinmental. if you see some weird movement and animation. Show us with screenshot or video.)
[*]Stun effect wasn't removed after the end of it's effect.
[*]Mana and stamina will be full after death.
[*]Some chat functions are fixed.
[/list]
[h1]Nerfs:[/h1]
[u][b]Hibachi[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Kidney Shot: Throw a shuriken to hit a vital point and paralyze the enemy. The paralyzed enemy cannot attack and use skills for 5/6/8 3/4/5 Seconds. Can be used on enemies with skill immunity.
[/list]
[h1]Then, Second thing: Road-Map![/h1]
[i]I can't see very distant future, but I can predict what will happen this month.[/i]
[b]09.2019 Estimated coming future content:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Match statistic system.
[*]Jungle system completing.
[*]New character: Partizan
[*]New character: Lacrimosa
[*]Lobby Shop system.
[*]Reward system.
[*](WIP)Rework in game Shop system.
[*]Adding some props in game(grass,rocks or more) its depend to my pc power.
[/olist]
[b]Also new loading card style coming soon! [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/38200c6347359a9b97ee9155be7deb559be80292.png[/img]
[i]That's really a nice remade, right?[/i]

[h1]Last, Patreon page has been published for supports![/h1]
[url=https://www.patreon.com/loco2]Link: https://www.patreon.com/loco2[/url]

[i][b]Why i did open a patreon page?[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Cause i am developing this game only me. So, solo working is hard to me with old PC, compiling, building and for more quality textures.
[/list]
[i][b]Can i get tester key with one time support?[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Actually yes, also if you want to support me with custom value; you can do it on to my paypal page.
[/list]
Thats all!
If you still interesting more FAQS for this game, [url=https://discord.gg/loco2]you can join our discord server: https://discord.gg/loco2[/url]
